clauses: Measure each funding source’s size by its number of spatial scan records.
Measure each funding source’s size by spatial scan records with both box dimensions present.
Measure each funding source’s size by its number of distinct projects with spatial scan data.
readings: Looking at spatial scan data (`scanspatial`) linked to projects (`projects.arcregistry` = `scanspatial.arcref`), which funding sources (`projects.fundflux`, treating a missing source as its own group) are bigger than average? For each funding source, work out the average ratio of bounding box Y (`boxy`) to bounding box Z (`boxz`), ignoring missing values, and how big it is. For the sources above the average size across funding sources, give one row with the average of their ratios, their combined size, and how far on average they exceed the average size. No rounding. Measure each funding source’s size by its number of spatial scan records.

Looking at spatial scan data (`scanspatial`) linked to projects (`projects.arcregistry` = `scanspatial.arcref`), which funding sources (`projects.fundflux`, treating a missing source as its own group) are bigger than average? For each funding source, work out the average ratio of bounding box Y (`boxy`) to bounding box Z (`boxz`), ignoring missing values, and how big it is. For the sources above the average size across funding sources, give one row with the average of their ratios, their combined size, and how far on average they exceed the average size. No rounding. Measure each funding source’s size by spatial scan records with both box dimensions present.

Looking at spatial scan data (`scanspatial`) linked to projects (`projects.arcregistry` = `scanspatial.arcref`), which funding sources (`projects.fundflux`, treating a missing source as its own group) are bigger than average? For each funding source, work out the average ratio of bounding box Y (`boxy`) to bounding box Z (`boxz`), ignoring missing values, and how big it is. For the sources above the average size across funding sources, give one row with the average of their ratios, their combined size, and how far on average they exceed the average size. No rounding. Measure each funding source’s size by its number of distinct projects with spatial scan data.
queries:
WITH funding_sources AS (
    SELECT
        p.fundflux,
        AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
        COUNT(*) AS source_size
    FROM scanspatial AS s
    JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
    GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
average_size AS (
    SELECT AVG(source_size) AS size FROM funding_sources
)
SELECT
    AVG(f.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    SUM(f.source_size) AS combined_size,
    AVG(f.source_size - a.size) AS avg_size_excess
FROM funding_sources AS f
CROSS JOIN average_size AS a
WHERE f.source_size > a.size

WITH funding_sources AS (
    SELECT
        p.fundflux,
        AVG(1.0 * s.boxy / s.boxz) AS avg_ratio,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN s.boxy IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS size
    FROM scanspatial AS s
    JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
    GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
average_size AS (
    SELECT AVG(size) AS value
    FROM funding_sources
)
SELECT
    AVG(f.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio,
    SUM(f.size) AS combined_size,
    AVG(f.size - a.value) AS average_size_excess
FROM funding_sources AS f
CROSS JOIN average_size AS a
WHERE f.size > a.value

WITH source_stats AS (
    SELECT
        p.fundflux,
        AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS source_size
    FROM scanspatial AS s
    JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
    GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(source_size) AS avg_size
    FROM source_stats
)
SELECT
    AVG(source_stats.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    SUM(source_stats.source_size) AS combined_size,
    AVG(source_stats.source_size - overall.avg_size) AS avg_size_excess
FROM source_stats
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE source_stats.source_size > overall.avg_size
